title: Permission-aware RAG answers inside a voice turn
scenario: LFG's pilot RAG Lambda read a Finance-only article to a contractor, invented an uncited bypass code and took 11 s on a busy morning, past Connect's 8 s synchronous limit. Rebuild it with Retrieve plus Converse: entitlement metadata filters, Bedrock Guardrails with contextual grounding, citation checks and a hard latency budget, tested against recorded Bedrock responses.
task: Map contact attributes to entitlements and build the Retrieve metadata filter server-side
Drop low-score chunks; hand off when nothing relevant is left
Converse with guardContent grounding_source/query qualifiers, guardrail trace, temperature 0
Reject guardrail interventions, CANNOT_ANSWER, uncited and out-of-range citations
Enforce a total latency budget with AbortController; SDK maxAttempts <= 2
Return a flat STRING_MAP the Connect flow can branch on
acceptance: Filters correct for unverified, employee and contractor callers and unaffected by the question
Each handoff reason produced on its recorded response; citations mapped to KB article ids
Slow Retrieve/Converse cut off near the budget
ANSWER.md shows the budget arithmetic and the async-mode alternative
